findings.issue: freshRejected only affects the Runtime host wrapper. baseEntry is the already-built fx.deps.entry whose authorizeConfiguration captured original fx.host in B2-runtime-fixture.ts:221-244; the claimed fresh Host refusal is not present on the actual entry admission dependency.

findings.issue: Unknown path awaits running before releasing its gate, without an owned timeout/race. Vitest outer 20s timeout does not unwind this async finally.
findings.impact: A missing cancel/drain implementation can leave the test and teardown waiting until the 60s tool timeout instead of guaranteeing cleanup.
findings.boundedCorrection: Use a bounded wait/race within the test so finally always releases the gate and drains the same running promise.

findings.issue: The cooperative tool resolves immediately on abort; deliverControl returning ready does not guarantee queued remains observable before the subsequent read.
findings.impact: A correctly completed fast cancellation can make this assertion fail even though applied/cancelled is valid.
findings.boundedCorrection: Remove this unnecessary intermediate queued assertion here, or tie it to an actual cleanup barrier; preserve terminal/release/applied checks. The pause test already covers durable queued while genuinely in flight.
